_note: Realism anchors for chains-proposed.json. Kept OUT of the chain records so those stay schema-exact. Each chain carries an overall demonstrated/partly-demonstrated/projected label and a per-step label derived from the technique's registrar status and the cited evidence. Defensive framing; no claim that any of these composed chains has occurred.

label_rules.demonstrated: Technique status DEMONSTRATED/CONFIRMED AND a specific CVE/paper/device fact supports the step as worded.
label_rules.partly_demonstrated: Technique demonstrated in lab or on offline datasets, but not shown on the named deployed device class, or only components are evidenced.
label_rules.projected: Technique status THEORETICAL/EMERGING, or the step is a plausible extrapolation not directly evidenced on hardware.

chains.overall_rationale: Initial access is demonstrated against real neurostimulator programmers/telemetry (CVEs below), but the closed-loop objective (T0023) and persistence (T0062) are THEORETICAL. No real incident of adaptive-DBS parameter corruption is claimed.
chains.device_class: Implanted adaptive deep-brain stimulator with a clinician programmer and patient telemetry (e.g. adaptive/closed-loop DBS systems; landscape: Medtronic BrainSense, Abbott Liberta RC).

steps.label: demonstrated
steps.evidence: Device/telemetry endpoint enumeration is routine recon; registrar status CONFIRMED.

steps.label: demonstrated
steps.evidence: CVE-2023-25931 (CVSS 6.8, CWE-620 Unverified Password Change) in Medtronic Pelvic Health clinician apps on the Smart Programmer; and the Conexus telemetry protocol 'does not implement authentication or authorization' (CVE-2019-6538, CVSS 9.3). Both show weak/absent authentication on real neurostimulator control links.

steps.label: partly_demonstrated
steps.evidence: Telemetry protocol manipulation demonstrated generally (registrar DEMONSTRATED, Schröder et al. 2025); parameter-shift-within-envelope on a specific adaptive DBS device not publicly shown.

steps.label: projected
steps.evidence: Closed-loop perturbation cascade is registrar THEORETICAL; extrapolated from closed-loop RNS/adaptive-DBS architecture, not demonstrated as an attack.

steps.label: projected
steps.evidence: Gradual drift is registrar THEORETICAL; a modeling construct for sub-threshold cumulative change.

chains.device_class: Consumer EEG headset with a companion app and cloud/SDK ML decoder (landscape: Emotiv EPOC X/Insight, InteraXon Muse, Neurosity Crown, Arctop Neural Decode SDK).
